newsitem.title: USA: Western Europe turning drier after light rain -WSC.
newsitem.headline: Western Europe turning drier after light rain -WSC.

text.p: Western Europe is now trending drier again in drought hit grain crop areas after showery weather and light to locally moderate rain fell in the past few days, private forecaster Weather Services Corp said.
Cool temperatures will dominate eastern Europe this period, also moving into the western FSU where it will turn cooler.
For the three to five day forecast, WSC said the British Isles will be dry and mild Thursday-Saturday.
Western Europe will be dry and seasonable in the east, warmer in the west.
Germany and Central Europe wuill have the chance of showers. It will be cool in the east and dry and seasonable in the west.
Mediterranean Europe will be wet and cool from Italy through Greece but generally dry and milder in western areas from Thursday to Saturday.
